changeSet.author: Artem Prokudin
changeSet.sql: update interaction i join (select distinct r.interaction_id, json_arrayagg(json_set(json_remove(r.reasoning, '$.hypothesis'), '$.hypotheses', if(json_type(json_extract(r.reasoning, '$.hypothesis')) = 'STRING', json_array(json_unquote(json_extract(r.reasoning, '$.hypothesis'))), json_array()))) over (partition by r.interaction_id order by r.reasoning_index rows between unbounded preceding and unbounded following) as reasonings from (select i.id as interaction_id, t.reasoning_index, t.reasoning from interaction i, json_table(i.reasonings, '$[*]' columns ( reasoning_index for ordinality, reasoning json path '$')) t) r) n on n.interaction_id = i.id set i.reasonings = n.reasonings;

rollback.sql: update interaction i join (select distinct r.interaction_id, json_arrayagg(json_set(json_remove(r.reasoning, '$.hypotheses'), '$.hypothesis', json_extract(r.reasoning, '$.hypotheses[0]'))) over (partition by r.interaction_id order by r.reasoning_index rows between unbounded preceding and unbounded following) as reasonings from (select i.id as interaction_id, t.reasoning_index, t.reasoning from interaction i, json_table(i.reasonings, '$[*]' columns ( reasoning_index for ordinality, reasoning json path '$')) t) r) n on n.interaction_id = i.id set i.reasonings = n.reasonings;
